plan.title: SRC-AWD-007 — Award L1 vendor and reject blank approval remark

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A and Vendor B bids in Master QCS.
Enable the required eRFX project setting before using the prepared event.
Open the awarding page for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units on the only line to the L1 vendor, Vendor B.
Verify one line is selected, exactly one of two vendors is awarded, and the proposal total is 10 × 90 = 900.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Complete any mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the proposal so it is available for approval.
Verify the submitted proposal shows the awarded vendor.
Verify the proposal displays the expected total value.
